test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tab ( id UInt64, message String, INDEX idx(message) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tab SELECT number, trimRight(if(number < 100000, repeat('clickhouse is a fast column oriented database system ', 4), repeat('the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog near the river ', 4))) FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE position(message, 'ickhous') > 0
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE positionUTF8(message, 'ickhous') != 0
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE positionCaseInsensitive(message, 'OLUMN') >= 1
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(message, 'OLUMN') > 0
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE position(message, 'rive') > 0
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE position(message, 'clickhouse is') = 1
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tab_large_dictionary ( id UInt64, message String, INDEX idx(message) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tab_large_dictionary SELECT number, concat('common message row', toString(number), if(number % 100000 = 0, ' selectiveneedle', '')) FROM numbers(5000000) SETTINGS max_insert_block_size = 10000000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 10000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
test.query: SELECT sum(id) FROM tab_large_dictionary WHERE position(message, 'selectiveneedle') > 0
SELECT sum(id) FROM tab_large_dictionary WHERE position(message, 'common') > 0
SELECT sum(id) FROM tab_large_dictionary WHERE position(message, 'selectiveneedle') > 0 SETTINGS use_text_index_like_evaluation_by_dictionary_scan = 0
SELECT sum(id) FROM tab_large_dictionary WHERE position(message, 'common') > 0 SETTINGS use_text_index_like_evaluation_by_dictionary_scan = 0
